name: kaleidara
description: Create, colour and publish print-aware colouring books and pattern collections.

interface.shortDescription: Create, colour and publish print-aware colouring books and pattern collections.
interface.longDescription: Kaleidara is an OpsPocket creative publishing workflow for ChatGPT and Codex. Plan mandalas, colouring pages, colour-by-numbers books, pattern collections and relevant book covers with visible production decisions, sourced inspiration, print-aware checks and clear output states. New workflows include create_book_cover for a branded, high-resolution 2:3 front-cover brief, and create_color_by_numbers_set for 2–4 deliberately different subject compositions with natural or psychedelic/DMT-inspired palette rules and numbered-region requirements. The package includes the reverse-page specification with a large quotation block and eight colour-test cubes. The repository contains a self-hostable Apps SDK/MCP foundation for capability discovery, cost estimation, real-provider generation, status polling and cancellation. A live provider endpoint and final KDP PDF, spine, deterministic segmentation and book-export engine still require separate configuration or implementation; this plugin does not pretend those services are hosted or finished.
defaultPrompt: Create a premium front cover for a lizards colour-by-numbers book with Kaleidara branding and a 2:3 KDP composition.
Create four distinct colour-by-numbers lizard pages with different compositions and a matching numbered palette key.
Create a sourced inspirational reverse-page brief with eight colour cubes.
Turn this concept into a colour-by-numbers production checklist.
Tell me what Kaleidara can do before a media provider is connected.
